name: Black-Glove Grounding
lines: (5 items) After taking direct damage three times within 5 seconds, you create a 5 meter area for 10 seconds that grants Grounding to you and group members, reducing the cost of roll dodging by 20% and increasing block mitigation by 12% for 15 seconds. This effect can occur once every 10 seconds.

name: Blackfeather Flight
lines: (5 items) When you Break Free, gain 100% Movement Speed for 7 seconds. This effect can occur once every 28 seconds.

name: Blessing of High Isle
lines: (5 items) When you are healed while in combat, increase your Weapon and Spell Damage by 369 for 5 seconds.

name: Blessing of the Potentates
lines: (2 items) Reduces your damage taken from Players by 3%.
(3 items) Reduces the cost of your Ultimate abilities by 15%.

name: Blind Path Induction
lines: (5 items) Increase the strength of your Damage Shields by 13% to you and targets within 15 meters of you. Increase your Healing Done by 13% to targets more than 15 meters away from you.

name: Blood Moon
lines: (2 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) When you deal damage with a melee Light Attack, you gain a stack of Blood Scent for 8 seconds. When you gain 5 stacks, you become Frenzied for 5 seconds, increasing your melee Light Attack damage by 2050 and attack speed by 50%. This effect can occur every 15 seconds.

name: Blooddrinker
lines: (3 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(5 items) Increases your Bleed damaging attacks by 20%.

name: Bloodlord's Embrace
lines: (1 item) Dealing damage with a Bash attack places a persistent, un-cleansable Blood Curse on an enemy. You can only have one Blood Cursed enemy at a time and dealing additional Bash damage moves the Blood Curse. When you Block a Blood Cursed enemy, restore 1605 Magicka to you. This effect can occur every 1 second.

name: Bloodspawn
lines: (2 items) When you take damage, you have a 6% chance to generate 13 Ultimate and increase your Physical and Spell Resistance by 3731 for 5 seconds. This effect can occur once every 5 seconds.

name: Bloodthorn's Touch
lines: (2 items) Adds 129 Weapon and Spell Damage
(5 items) When you deal direct damage, you restore 800 Magicka and Stamina. This effect can occur once every 5 seconds.
